_comment: Stage 8 evaluation protocol. Written and hashed into data/processed/backtesting/stage8_pretest_lock.json BEFORE the reserved Test split is opened. Nothing here may be changed after Test access except through a documented amendment (scripts/10_backtest_portfolios.py --amendment).
research_question: Does the Full EWS-enhanced portfolio (P2) improve realized downside protection and risk-adjusted performance beyond the strategic benchmark (P0) and the simpler HMM-based allocation (P1), after the conservative t+1 execution delay and transaction costs?
terminology: Sequential out-of-sample portfolio backtest with FROZEN regime / early-warning models (no refit, no retraining schedule) and causally re-estimated portfolio risk inputs (Ledoit-Wolf covariance re-estimated at every weekly decision from returns through the decision date).

evaluation_window.test_start_rule: first session of the Stage 3 test split (split_manifest.json; expected 2020-01-02)
evaluation_window.test_end_rule: last session of the frozen local test split (not chosen by the researcher)
evaluation_window.wealth_normalization: every strategy's wealth = 1.0 at the close of the last Validation session; the first Test return is that of the first Test session
evaluation_window.pre_test_history: Train / Validation sessions are used only to carry the strategies' holdings and decision state forward to the Test start; their realized returns are verified for accounting but are not reported as performance

primary_portfolios.P0_strategic: frozen strategic benchmark, weekly 1% no-trade band, turnover cap 20% (Stage 7 rule, posture = benchmark)
primary_portfolios.P1_regime_aware: role baseline_regime only; d1 = min(1, a * baseline_p_non_normal), a from the Stage 7 handoff (Train-calibrated)
primary_portfolios.P2_ews_enhanced: role challenger_ews only; d2 = level map GREEN 0, AMBER 1/3, ORANGE 2/3, RED 1, RECOVERY 1/3

B1_60_40.rule: same weekly calendar and conservative_close_t_plus_1 execution; trade back to 60/40 when the one-way distance exceeds the 1% no-trade band; no turnover cap; same cost model; outside the nine-ETF mandate limits (contextual only)

B2_constant_defensiveness.rule: identical optimizer, constraints, calendar, execution and costs as P1/P2 with a CONSTANT defensiveness d
B2_constant_defensiveness.d_source: Stage 7 portfolio_policy_manifest.json saturation.train_mean_d2 (the matched mean Train defensiveness of P1 and P2)

B3_strategic_buy_and_hold.rule: strategic weights held from the close of the last Validation session, never rebalanced, no costs (contextual only; not a substitute for P0)

initialization.primary: continuation: every strategy is run sequentially from its first eligible Stage 7 decision (benchmark holdings at that date) through Train and Validation; its holdings, previous target and pending order at the close of the last Validation session are carried into Test
initialization.sensitivity: restart: every strategy holds the strategic benchmark at the close of the last Validation session (B1 holds 60/40); signals are NOT reset
initialization.boundary_week: the calendar week containing the last Validation session is completed with Test sessions by the frozen weekly rule (decision on the last session of that Monday-Sunday week); no other decision is added

decision_rule.optimizer: Stage 7 primary policy (portfolio_optimizer.solve_policy, target_then_trade), reused without modification
decision_rule.pre_trade_weights_at_decision: actual ledger holdings at the close of the decision date t (known at t). They equal the Stage 7 ex-ante proxy (previous target drifted through t) whenever the previous order was executed in full; they differ only after a hold inside the no-trade band or an execution-day projection (the Stage 7 proxy would then ignore realized drift).
decision_rule.risk_inputs: Ledoit-Wolf 504 sessions, minimum 252, equilibrium expected returns (SR_b 0.30), all from simple returns dated <= t
decision_rule.signals: date-t value of the portfolio's own role; intra-week signals are not acted upon

execution.convention: conservative_close_t_plus_1: decision after the close of t; execution at the close of t+1; first return of the new holdings is that of t+2; holdings held before the execution earn the return of t+1
execution.hold_orders: a decision inside the no-trade band is an explicit no-trade order (no execution, holdings keep drifting)
execution.trade_orders: at the close of t+1 compute the actual pre-trade weights (drift through t+1). If 0.5*sum|target - pre| <= the decision's turnover cap, execute the decision-time target exactly; otherwise execute pre + (cap / TO) * (target - pre) (cap-preserving straight-line projection, the Stage 7 transition rule). No t+1 signal is used.
execution.price_assumption: adjusted close of t+1 (adjusted total-return series; not proof of historical fills)
execution.costs: deducted from wealth at the execution close, pro rata across holdings, so post-trade weights equal the executed target

transaction_costs.basis: bps of GROSS traded notional = sum_i |w_post,i - w_pre,i| = 2 x one-way turnover
transaction_costs.stress_indicator: trailing 21-session SPY realized volatility (simple returns through the decision date t, annualized) above the Train-calibrated threshold in the Stage 7 handoff; evaluated at t, applied to the execution at t+1; identical for every portfolio; uses no HMM / EWS role signal

return_accounting.inputs: daily log returns of adjusted closes from the split files, converted exactly to simple returns R = exp(r) - 1
return_accounting.portfolio_return: R_p,t = sum_i w_i,t-1 R_i,t with the weights actually held over the session (never a weighted sum of log returns)
return_accounting.gross: returns of the actual holdings before trading costs (the trading path is identical with and without costs because costs are deducted pro rata)
return_accounting.net: (1 + gross_t) * (1 - cost_fraction_t) - 1 on execution sessions, gross otherwise

metrics.risk_free_for_evaluation: realized daily simple return of BIL (evaluation benchmark only; never added to portfolio returns)
metrics.cagr: wealth_T ^ (252 / T) - 1, T = number of Test sessions
metrics.volatility: sample standard deviation of daily returns x sqrt(252)
metrics.sharpe: mean(daily excess return over BIL) x 252 / (std(daily excess) x sqrt(252))
metrics.sortino: mean daily excess x 252 / downside deviation; downside deviation = sqrt(mean(min(excess, 0)^2)) x sqrt(252)
metrics.max_drawdown: minimum of wealth / running maximum - 1 on the daily net wealth path (initial 1.0 included)
metrics.var_cvar: 95% historical daily VaR / CVaR of returns (Stage 7 Rockafellar-Uryasev convention)
metrics.tracking_error_information_ratio: std / mean of daily active returns vs the reference, annualized

stress_analysis.window_origin: calendar-month boundaries taken from the public macro chronology named in the Stage 8 brief (pandemic shock 2020, inflation / tightening 2022, later normalization); not chosen from any portfolio result
stress_analysis.objective_events: SPY drawdown events in Test by the frozen Stage 6 rule: onset when cumulative log return falls 5% below its running peak, re-armed above -2.5%; major events have a trough <= -10%
stress_analysis.executable_protection: a de-risking execution counts as protection for an event only if its EXECUTION date is before the event onset date; executions between onset and trough are reactions
stress_analysis.de_risking_execution: an execution that lowers the portfolio's equity weight AND leaves it at least 1 percentage point below the strategic equity weight (50%), i.e. a move into a defensive posture rather than a rebalance back to the benchmark; searched from 21 sessions before the event peak to the trough
stress_analysis.recovery_participation: net return from the close of the trough date over the next 63 sessions (or to the sample end), compared with P0

attribution.method: daily holdings-based: active_gross_t = sum_i (w_A,i,t-1 - w_B,i,t-1) R_i,t, split per group into an average-exposure part (Test-average weight difference x return; descriptive, uses the whole Test period) and a timing part (deviation from that average x return); cost effect = net active - gross active; compounding residual = terminal wealth difference - sum of daily net active returns

risk_matching.regression: r_P - rf = alpha + beta (r_P0 - rf) + e with Newey-West standard errors (alpha = return not explained by the portfolio's exposure to the strategic benchmark)
risk_matching.descriptive_normalization: ex-post volatility-matched excess returns (scaled to P0's realized Test volatility); labelled DESCRIPTIVE, not a tradable strategy
risk_matching.capture: up / down capture vs P0 and the mean return on P0's worst 5% of days

statistics.mean_active_return: Newey-West (Bartlett) HAC standard error, lag = floor(4 (T/100)^(2/9)), normal 95% interval, two-sided p-value; Holm adjustment across the three primary comparisons

bootstrap.method: stationary bootstrap (Politis-Romano), paired across all portfolios and BIL

bootstrapped_statistics: maximum drawdown difference (approximate: resampled paths do not preserve the full crash sequence)
statistics.caveat: annualized Sharpe, CAGR and maximum drawdown are path statistics, not independent observations; the number of independent stress episodes is reported

decision_rules.statistically_supported: 95% stationary-bootstrap interval (block 21) of the net Sharpe difference excludes 0
decision_rules.robust_to_costs: the sign of the net Sharpe difference is the same at 5, 10 and 25 bps
decision_rules.similar_to_constant: |net Sharpe difference vs B2| < 0.10 and its 95% interval contains 0
decision_rules.explained_by_exposure: the average-exposure part of the gross active return is larger in absolute value than the timing part (exposure-driven); otherwise timing-driven, called statistically supported only if the 95% interval of the regression alpha on the reference excludes 0

outcome_classification.Outcome 1 - Full EWS adds credible incre: P2 - P1 net Sharpe difference >= 0.10 with a 95% interval excluding 0, P2 - P0 net Sharpe interval excluding 0 on the positive side, and both robust to costs
outcome_classification.Outcome 3 - Strategic allocation remains: both P1 - P0 and P2 - P0 net Sharpe differences <= 0 at 10 bps
outcome_classification.Outcome 2 - Simple HMM allocation is suf: not Outcome 1; P1 - P0 net Sharpe difference > 0 with a 95% interval excluding 0; and P2 - P1 difference < 0.10 or its interval contains 0

model_variants.mapping_P1_full_range_P2_continuous: d1 = p, d2 = continuous EWS score map (Stage 7 permitted sensitivity)

sensitivity.model_variant_protocol: each variant and its reference restart from the strategic benchmark at the Test start; robustness evidence only; the primary policy is never replaced

release_vocabulary.WARN: valid implementation with a documented limitation or non-blocking numerical warning
release_vocabulary.FAIL: genuine integrity, causality, accounting or constraint failure

final_status_rule.COMPLETE WITH LIMITATIONS: no FAIL and at least one WARN
final_status_rule.COMPLETE: all checks PASS (documented research limitations still apply)

restrictions: No frozen HMM, AR(1), AR-HMM, BOCPD or EWS parameter, threshold, weight or mapping is re-estimated or changed.
No Stage 7 policy parameter (risk budget, constraints, band, cap, penalties, solver, costs) is changed.
No new comparator, window, metric, block length or sensitivity case is added after Test access.
No grid search over risk aversion, thresholds, hazard, K, multipliers, rebalance frequency, caps or penalties.
A sensitivity variant never replaces the primary policy.
A genuine error found after Test access is corrected only as a labelled amendment that preserves the original result.
